name: jawsome-agents
description: Harness-agnostic agent skills built on the Agent Skills spec, plus Claude Code-only plugins

plugins.name: standards
plugins.description: Mines a repo's review history into coding standards that agents follow while they write code, and prunes the rules agents already follow.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Turns conventions into checks the toolchain runs, and moves the steps a skill does by hand into scripts and narrow judgment-model questions.

plugins.name: playbook
plugins.description: Extends pstack's poteto-mode playbooks with team and personal playbook files, ordered by their extends chains, delivers shared packs of them to any repo, and validates them against each pstack release.

plugins.name: claudecode-smart-usage
plugins.description: Picks the reasoning effort for each prompt you send, and makes every subagent spawn name its model and effort on purpose.

plugins.name: pocket-deck-kit
plugins.description: Rules paraphrase, engine design, original glyphs and fonts, sound design and project playbook for building a private, non-monetized pocket trading-card game that plays like the original mobile card game on phone, tablet and desktop.

plugins.name: reference-craft
plugins.description: Skills for building against a reference UI: measure screenshots and screen recordings, including sound timing, into tagged, reproducible numbers while spending few image tokens.

plugins.name: meetings
plugins.description: Amie calendar, todos, meeting notes and Gmail over MCP, as one installable plugin

plugins.name: youtube
plugins.description: Finds a YouTube video from a link, a title or a photo of the player, and saves its timestamped transcript to a file for summaries and quotes.
